{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for refunded orders and filter to completed orders only
completed_only = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
print('Cross-tabulation of customer_segment by channel:')
print(pd.crosstab(completed_only['channel'], completed_only['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rates by channel, stratified by customer_segment
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()

# Display conversion rates
print('\nConversion rates by channel and segment:')
print(conversion_rates)

# Compute overall conversion rates by channel (unadjusted)
overall_conversion = completed_only.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('\nUnadjusted overall conversion rates:')
print(overall_conversion)"}
